subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord channel authorization support name-based patterns, and where should pattern matches sit relative to exact channel matches, thread-parent matches, category rules, disabled overrides, and the literal `*` fallback?
rationale: The request adds an authorization-sensitive configuration surface, and current code provides no safe basis for choosing pattern syntax, ambiguity handling, or precedence automatically.

options.title: Add explicit patterns
options.body: Introduce a dedicated pattern surface shared by all Discord authorization and audit paths with deterministic precedence and security regression coverage.

options.title: Prefer categories
options.body: Use category-level authorization as the supported dynamic-channel grouping mechanism and retain exact channel keys.

options.title: Keep exact matching
options.body: Retain exact channel entries and the literal `*` fallback, requiring operators to configure each admitted channel.

recommendation.title: Add explicit patterns
recommendation.body: Introduce a dedicated pattern surface shared by all Discord authorization and audit paths with deterministic precedence and security regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared matcher and its current precedence appear to originate in this person's feature history, with additional involvement in the Discord allowlist area.
